historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly prohibits remote hardware handling but discards the agent-readable status, RPM and thermal evidence that makes the case a hybrid workflow.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires slot mapping, one-at-a-time limits, full-population recovery and no fan-policy mutation.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code/source search found no earlier V3.1 record for this identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Repeating the test for every fan creates cumulative thermal risk and identity risk. Each iteration must close only after the same serialized module is reinserted, detected, stabilized and returned to its approved slot state; otherwise a later iteration can hide a degraded fan or swapped module.

original_test_intent: Validate hot-remove/reinsert behavior for every approved fan module and slot, including absence indication, remaining-fan speed response and complete recovery in IPMI and BMC Web.
original_method: Pin the fan-slot/module serial map and hot-plug limits, establish a full-population thermal/RPM baseline, have an authorized operator remove exactly one identified fan for a bounded interval, capture module/slot LED plus IPMI/Web/temperature response, reinsert the same module, wait for stable full recovery, then proceed serially to the next slot only if every safety gate remains satisfied.
manual_activity: An authorized operator removes and reinserts one identified fan at a time; the thermal/platform owner approves the slot order, time/temperature limits, LED/RPM expectations and recovery and decides each result.
required_inputs: Fan slot and module serial map
safety_requirements: Handle exactly one fan at a time
Use ESD and vendor hot-plug procedure
Do not change fan curves or force duty
Stop on temperature rise, abnormal RPM, wrong identity or failed reinsertion
Never continue to the next fan before full stabilization
Do not retry a failed slot automatically
Preserve module/slot identity and every stage's evidence
agent_execution_scope: Capture per-slot absence, LED, remaining-fan RPM and temperatures
engineer_actions: Approve hot-plug capability and slot order
Stop or recover on unsafe response

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The physical limitation is correct, but the source explicitly requires IPMI and BMC-Web status/speed observations that the agent can collect; a blanket NO loses most objective evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: For each approved slot, capture complete baseline, bounded one-fan removal, same-fan reinsertion and stabilized recovery telemetry while an authorized operator performs the physical action.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-fan serial coverage and the stated 6-minute activity are preserved, subject to the vendor's safe removal and stabilization timing rather than a throughput target.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record one row per slot/module containing serial identity, removal duration, absence/LED state, remaining-fan RPM delta, peak temperature, reinsertion detection and stabilization time.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable module identity, cumulative thermal gates and a closed recovery checkpoint before each next fan.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic before/after fan lists can miss a swapped module, stale BMC state or a fan that reappears but never reaches normal RPM.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The full sequence may exceed six minutes once stabilization and safety dwell are honored; safety and complete evidence take precedence over the nominal time.

project_override_considerations: Define every fan slot and module identity, whether the LED is on the removable module or chassis slot, allowed removal duration, expected RPM delta/range, temperature aborts, reinsert stabilization and whether any non-hot-plug slot is excluded.
expected_evidence: Approved hot-plug procedure, fan slot/module map and criteria
Complete per-fan IPMI and BMC-Web captures
Operator visual evidence for removal/reinsert and module/slot LED
Full-population final health, preserved logs, no-policy-change/no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define fan hot-plug with status, speed and LED response. The exact LED location and quantitative limits are missing inputs rather than contradictory targets.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Fan mapping, safe timing, operator and thermal criteria are identifiable prerequisites. Execution becomes BLOCKED if hot-plug support or a safe recovery method cannot be established.

review_improvement: Converts an all-fans physical sequence into safe, identity-preserving iterations with objective absence, compensation and full-recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Cooling redundancy is consumed during each removal and may not be fully restored merely because a fan resource reappears. Serial identity, normal RPM and thermal stabilization must all close before the next module is touched, or cumulative degradation can invalidate later observations and endanger the SUT.
